note: I&M Bank (Rwanda)'s products and services tariff, effective May 2026, was read. Its cards section prices the Visa Gold Credit card: FRW 30,000 for a new card, a renewal or a replacement (written as the issue fee; a renewal at the card's expiry and a replacement aren't modelled) and an annual card anniversary fee of FRW 30,000 (the yearly fee). It gives the card's interest as 'Base Rate +/-', and the same tariff's loans section states the base rate and the margin for retail lending: 'Retail Banking: Base Rate 16.5% + Margin Min -2.5% to Max 3.45%'. Reading: the card's rate is the bank's base rate of 16.5% plus or minus the retail margin, so 14.00% to 19.95% a year (the tariff states the base rate as a yearly rate, as Rwandan banks' base rates are; it isn't marked effective, so it's written as nominal), the holder priced within the range. The 'Late penalty fee for Credit cards' of 1% per month names no base, so it isn't written. The tariff's charges are 'exclusive of VAT, where applicable' without the VAT rate, so no tax is written. Minimum payment, grace days, cash advance, foreign spending and over-limit terms aren't published for the card. Bank of Kigali's card pages served its home page shell (2026-10-30), so I&M is the one bank written.
